description: Geometry priors for low-fidelity hand-drawn UI sketches.

mobile.policy: Preserve user layout while correcting perspective and orientation before letterboxing.

desktop.policy: Preserve global layout and avoid stretching individual UI regions.

rectangles.description: Recover near-rectangular UI containers, images, cards, fields, and buttons into straight-edged boxes when confidence is high.

circles.description: Recover near-circular icons, avatars, radio buttons, and floating controls into circles or square icon boxes when confidence is high.

lines.description: Snap nearly horizontal or vertical strokes that represent dividers, nav bars, or input borders.

future_pipeline: detect screen boundary and apply homography
remap element boxes to normalized viewport
